summary: Ero Copper Corp. filed a Form 6-K containing a press release announcing its 2026 Capital Markets Day scheduled for September 14, 2026, in São Paulo, Brazil, with a live webcast. The event is a routine investor presentation with no transaction, strategic action, or board-level changes disclosed. The filing only provides logistical details for the event and reiterates general company information about its copper and gold assets and the Furnas project earn-in. No deal terms, premium, or special-situation event is referenced; this is an ordinary corporate communication not constituting a special situation.
